data.title: Accessible Goa Getaway: 3 Days from Pune for Priya
data.summary: This 3-day trip from Pune to Goa is designed for Priya, who uses a manual wheelchair and prefers step-free access. The itinerary focuses on beaches and food, with travel, accommodation, and activities chosen for their likely suitability for wheelchair users. All accessibility details must be checked directly with venues before booking.

traveler.notes: Budget is 30,000 INR. Priya uses a manual wheelchair and portable ramp. She prefers step-free access and accessible restrooms. Emergency contact is Aman (+91 98xxxxxx01). Accessibility details below must be confirmed before booking. Budget options chosen where possible.

items.note: Book an aisle seat near the front and request early boarding. Confirm wheelchair assistance with the airline. Carry portable ramp for boarding if needed. Source: airline websites.

items.note: Arrange a taxi with space for a wheelchair. Contact Goa Miles or local operators for accessible vehicles. Source: Goa Miles website.

tips: Contact all hotels, beaches, and restaurants in advance to confirm step-free access, ramps, and accessible restrooms.
Pre-book wheelchair assistance with airlines and request an aisle seat near the front.
Carry your portable ramp and check if beach wheelchairs are available at major beaches.
Use ride-hailing apps like Goa Miles and specify your accessibility needs when booking taxis.
Keep emergency contacts and medical information handy during travel.
Check accessibility sources: hotel and airline official websites, Goa Tourism (goa-tourism.com), and reviews on TripAdvisor and Google Maps.

items.subject: Request for Wheelchair Assistance and Seating Preferences: Pune-Goa Flights
items.body:
Dear IndiGo Team,

I am booked to travel from Pune to Goa and back. I use a manual wheelchair and will be carrying a portable ramp. I kindly request wheelchair assistance at both airports, early boarding, and an aisle seat near the front of the aircraft for both flights. Please confirm that these arrangements can be made and let me know if you need any further information.

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to your written confirmation.

Best regards,
Priya

turns.user: The lift at my hotel is broken and my room is on the 4th floor. What now?

data.issue: Hotel lift is broken and Priya's room is on the 4th floor, making it inaccessible for her wheelchair.

options.title: Request Immediate Room Change to Ground Floor
options.detail: Ask the hotel staff to move Priya to a ground floor room that is step-free and accessible. This is the fastest and safest solution if such a room is available.
options.cost_hint: Usually no extra charge if within same room category.

options.title: Request Hotel Assistance for Temporary Relocation
options.detail: Ask the hotel to arrange a transfer to a nearby accessible hotel at the same price, or to cover the cost difference if needed. Ensure the new hotel is step-free and accessible.
options.cost_hint: Hotel may cover cost if they cannot provide access; check before agreeing.

options.title: Contact Travel Agent or Booking Platform for Emergency Support
options.detail: If the hotel cannot help, contact the travel agent or booking website's emergency support line. Request their help to find accessible accommodation nearby and arrange a refund or alternative booking.
options.cost_hint: May involve price difference for new hotel; some platforms offer emergency support at no extra cost.
